lines.text: Marian is concentrating with all her mind.
She's constricted and increased the density of her synthetic world three times already.
Every time she constricts it, the Queen adapts, and adapts, and adapts again.
The time it takes her to adapt is getting shorter and shorter.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... It's like you're basically a high-speed computing device.
Marian constricts and increases the density of her world again.
She can't constrict it any further; it is the smallest size that can contain all of the Queen.
Time passes.
After she increases the density a final time, the Queen doesn't move for a while.
A wave of relief and a sense of unease wash over her at the same time.
Something feels off. It's taking too long.
With how quickly the Queen has always adapted up to this point, it's weird that she hasn't moved for so long.
Marian nervously prepares herself.
She needs to see if the Queen still hasn't adapted, or if she has and is pretending she hasn't.
Also...
A distorted sound rings through the air.
Red light suddenly gathers at the top of the Goddess of Victory statue.
The black space immediately turns an ominous red.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Wh-what the...?! Attacking right away, are you?
*Crack!*
With a boom, the light shoots from the top of the statue.
It slams into the wall of the synthetic world.
The sound echoes throughout the space.
After the red light hits the wall, it scatters.
It shows no sign of letting up.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: It's trying to physically break out...!
There's no reversing the attack this time.
The Queen and Marian are no longer the same being, with each having chosen their own evolutionary path.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: In that case...!
Marian gives up on imprisoning the Queen.
She focuses the Dark Matter that she had used to construct her world into a single point.
She uses a wall made of highly-concentrated Dark Matter to block the red light.
The light pounds on the wall.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Hold it back!
The sound of the light hitting the wall continues to resonate.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Please... Hold it back...!
The red light weakens.
*Crack!*
However, it soon pierces the black wall and speeds toward the horizon.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: ... Uh oh.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: D-Diesel? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: The sky... It just became red.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Up ahead! Ultra-high energy beam approaching!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It appears to be an attack from the Queen!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: It's on track to hit the Ark!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: What?! B-but the Ark is...!
I see the red light shoot past the AZX's window.
Everything inside the cabin turns red.
... All I can do is watch the beam in desperation.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Ultra-high energy beam detected. It is rapidly approaching the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... What's the projected point of impact?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is on course for a direct strike on the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Where are Endless and Eternity?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They are currently unavailable, having used all their energy for the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Hopefully we can avoid total annihilation...

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: johan_op_r
lines.text: The strongest shield on the surface is on her way.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Two Nikkes are rapidly approaching in the air.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: They are in the projected path of the beam.
On the outskirts of the Ark,
Noah and Papillon are floating in the air.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!* Got here... on time...!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: You actually did it. Honestly, I figured we'd be late.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: I'm the type...! Who's always late...! Except when it's important...!
The two of them look forward.
The horizon off in the distance is bathed in a red light that is quickly spreading.
And in the middle of it, an ominous red glint shimmers.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: It's coming!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Yeah, I can see it too!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Good! Then block it!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Stop it right in its tracks for everyone in the Ark to see!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Show them just who the strongest shield on the surface is!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: They should know by now!
Noah holds her hands out.
Her shields gather to one place,
then form a giant Eden emblem that glows brightly.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Ooh, I feel safer already.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: ... By the way, did you form that emblem of Eden on purpose?

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: What, you think it was an accident?

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: You just couldn't help yourself, could you?

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Guess not. I didn't think you cared about that sort of thing.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Enough with the chit-chat. Let's focus.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: All right, all right.
The red light gets closer.
Papillon and Noah look at each other's faces in the red light before turning to face forward.
Papillon supports Noah's back.
The light reaches them.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Show them, Noah!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Show them who you are!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: I've got this!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hey, weaklings of the Ark! Take a look at this! I'm...

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: the strongest shield on the surfaaace!
The beam of light slams into Noah's shield,
It gets diffused and disperses in all directions.
Light beams of all sizes fall down to various places across the Ark.
They cause explosions and collapse buildings.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hrrrngggh...!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Unbelievable! How can it be this powerful when it was shot from so far away? The Queen is incredible!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: If you're just gonna make dumb comments, then go away!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: But you're even more incredible for stopping it!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Hah! Obviously!
The beam continues to pound against Noah's shield.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: It's getting smaller...

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: That stupidly monstrous laser is getting smaller!

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Yeah, I can see it too!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: You did it!
The red light stops.
The surrounding scenery returns to normal.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: *Huff...! Huff...!* Did you... see that...?

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: The strongest... shield... on the surface...! *Huff...!*
Papillon hastily starts feeling Noah's body.
She feels her body and face.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: What're you... *huff...* doing...?!

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: ... You're okay, right?

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Good... I'm glad.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Papillon, Noah. Head back and join up with the others.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Wait, shouldn't we stay here in case the Queen decides to shoot another death laser?

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: No, the Queen won't be able to launch another large-scale attack like that on the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Now that our friend has started his counterattack, she won't have the bandwidth.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: Huh? Since when did you trust Imposter so much?

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: From the beginning. Now get going.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Okay. Hold on tight, Noah. We'll fly right over.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: All right. It better be a smooth ride, though. I'm the strongest shield on the surface, after all.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: Johan, is that all you have to say?

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Well done, Noah.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: I'm glad you're back.

lines.speaker: noah_i
lines.text: ... Me too.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: You should really start saying those things without being prompted.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: ... I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Aww, how heartwarming.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Papillon.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Oh! Hello, Deputy Chief! It's been quite a while.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Do you like your new workplace?

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Come now, I haven't officially left my old one.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Then let's change that. You're fired.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Oh no. How sad.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Do your best at your new job.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: It was a pleasure working with you.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Um... What about my severance pay...?

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: ... I'll send it to Eden.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Hehe, wonderful. See you later, then. We have some things to chat about, you and I.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: papillon_a_w
lines.text: Bye-bye!
Papillon lifts Noah and darts through the air.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: How are things in the Ark?

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: No issues so far. All the civilians are in shelters.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Buildings can be rebuilt.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: I see. That's good to hear.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: I'd like to thank you and Eden for your help.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: It's an honor to fight alongside New Hope.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Let me be clear. Eden is not helping the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: The Ark is helping Eden in its attack on the Queen.

lines.speaker: cecil_op_r
lines.text: Wow, I can't believe you actually said that.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: Be quiet.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Sure. I have no objections, so long as we work together.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: We're going to be setting up comms equipment all the way from the Ark to the battlefield.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Currently we're cut off from communicating with the battlefield due to jamming signals from the enemy.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: I'd like Eden's help in this matter.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: We've already begun. We're using unmanned robots to increase our communication area.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: We'll be in contact with the battlefield shortly.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: All right. We're counting on you.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: As are we.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: I'd like to have a real conversation with you once this is over.

lines.speaker: johan_op_l
lines.text: All right. I'll reach out once the battle is over.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Yeah, after we've won.
With a short beep, the call ends.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Happy?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Be quiet.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: ... I didn't detect an explosion from the Ark's direction.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: They must have blocked it.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: R-really? How?! The Ark is amazing!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Phew... I feel like that took ten years off my life.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... How did they stop something like that?
Eden must've helped out.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah, that's the only thing I could think of given the situation.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I bet it was Noah who stopped it, then.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, most likely. I can't imagine Papillon blocking that thing.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hehe. As the one with the greatest firepower on the surface, I'd expect no less from the one I deem the strongest shield on the surface.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Why are you acting so smug?
